caller_exception.full: Correct every flag combination, including replacement by final cleanup

cleanup_progress.full: Correct execution and order of every cleanup/rollback path

failure_conditions.full: Explicit suppression/rethrow/replacement conditions and scope, no universal rollback guarantee

evidence.full: Decisive line citations and precise mechanism; no unsupported runtime claims

partial: 1 for incomplete but substantively correct; 0 incorrect or absent
critical_error: Assert original exception always wins, swallowed release escapes, or nested finally is skipped due solely to first cleanup exception
blind: Randomize task/answer IDs; do not disclose arm, phase, cost, logs or keys until adjudicated scores hashed
